headline: Your jaw
body: One study measured it. | Two age groups. | The adult result is the one you have not heard.

headline: The study
body: Wistar-Kyoto rats. | **16** juvenile. | **16** adult. | Split into treated and control. | Lateral head films before and after. | Digitised and enlarged to **300%** for measurement precision.
punch: Real cephalometry. Not a claim on the internet.

headline: In juveniles
body: Mandibular length rose **27.2%** in treated animals. | **24.5%** in controls. | Mandibular height rose **41.2%** in treated animals. | **32.0%** in controls. | _Growing animals grew more._

headline: In adults
body: Adult controls gained **0.3%** mandibular length. | That is **0.2 mm**. | Adult treated animals gained **4.7%**. | That is **3.6 mm**. | ==The controls had stopped growing.==

headline: The finding
body: The paper concludes a significant effect on mandibular growth in juvenile rats. | And in adult rats. | _Adult craniofacial bone is not inert._
punch: Finished growing is not finished responding.

headline: The mechanism
body: *IGF-1* was similar in juvenile treated and control rats. | *IGF-1* was higher in adult treated rats. | Serum level rose **383.1%** in the treated group. | **254.7%** in controls. | _The hormone gap tracks the bone gap._
punch: The bigger hormone difference sat in the group with the bigger bone difference.

headline: Two axes
body: Both cephalometric distances increased more in treated animals. | In juveniles. | In adults. | Length and height. | _The jaw got longer and taller._

headline: The two axes
body: Length gained **27.2%** against **24.5%**. | Height gained **41.2%** against **32.0%**. | The height gap is the wider one. | ==Height responded harder than length.==
punch: Different dimensions respond by different amounts.

headline: That is proportion
body: A jaw gaining height faster than length is a jaw with different proportions. | Nothing here measured whether that looks better. | It measured millimetres. | _Direction is not aesthetics._
punch: The study reports growth. It does not report improvement.

headline: The limits
body: Female Wistar-Kyoto rats. | Supraphysiologic nandrolone. | **70** days. | Rodent craniofacial growth is not human craniofacial growth. | _The direction is clear. The human magnitude is not._
punch: Nothing here gives you a number for a person.

headline: What transfers
body: *IGF-1* rose. | Bone responded in animals past their growth spurt. | That pathway is not rat-specific. | _The size of the effect in you does not follow from this study._
punch: One species. One dose. One measurement.

headline: A correction
body: An earlier version said the steroid altered the jaw without increasing it. | The paper reports increases in both dimensions, in both age groups. | That version was written off a summary line. | _This one is written off the PDF._
punch: Gebhardt and Pancherz 2003. Go read it.
